---
title: "Quarto Notebooks"
---

Reproducible scientific notebooks, rendered with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and managed with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). Part of the [Notebook Gallery](https://radek-dev.github.io/notebook-gallery/).

| Notebook | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| [The Central Limit Theorem](clt.qmd) | Simulation showing sample means becoming normal, on synthetic data |

## Reproduce

```sh
git clone https://github.com/radek-dev/quarto-notebooks
cd quarto-notebooks
uv sync
uv run quarto render
```
